user.title: Aqua Medic pump
user.description: Unofficial integration, not made or endorsed by Aqua Medic. Use at your own risk. Pumps found on your network are listed; the passcode is fetched from the pump itself.

manual.title: Enter pump address
manual.description: No pump answered the network search. Enter the IP address of the pump's Wi-Fi module (see your router). Unofficial integration - use at your own risk.

discovery_confirm.title: Aqua Medic pump found
discovery_confirm.description: {name} was found at {host}. Set it up? The passcode is fetched from the pump. Unofficial integration - use at your own risk.

reconfigure.title: Change pump address
reconfigure.description: New IP address or hostname of {name}. Normally not needed: the integration finds a pump at a new address by itself within about 10 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the pump (TCP port 12416).
error.needs_binding: The pump did not hand out its passcode. Power-cycle the pump or press its Wi-Fi button briefly, then try again.
error.unsupported: This is a Gizwits device, but not a known Aqua Medic pump.
error.wrong_device: A different pump answers at this address.

abort.already_configured: This pump is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This pump is already being set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Address changed, the pump is reconnecting.
abort.unsupported: This is not a supported Aqua Medic pump.
